paragraphs.text:
Your fall stops on a stone floor; lose 1D3 hit points. If you have 
Language (Hieroglyphics) go to 345. 
Your only route is through sections J to I to K. In section-K, 
a shaft leads down, with handholds carved into the wall. If you 
succeed with an INT roll, go to 366; if you fail, you climb down 
and go to 395. 
(345, 366, 371)
